Looking for a varied role in the logistics sector?
Would you like to join an international working environment?
Then SD Worx Jobs has the perfect opportunity for you! 

For a growing logistics company in the Willebroek region, SD Worx Jobs is looking for a Warehouse Operator.

Your responsibilitiesµ

No two days are the same! As a key player in the logistics process, you help ensure that operations run smoothly and efficiently.

• Receive incoming goods and place them in the correct warehouse locations.

• Pick and pack online orders for shipment.

• Perform quality checks to ensure high service standards.

• Monitor stock levels and report shortages in a timely manner.

• You speak and understand English.

• Previous experience in logistics is preferred.

Are you passionate about transport and logistics? Bleckmann is looking for you! 

We are looking for orderpicker for the Bleckmann Ghent. You will be working in the morning shift (05u48 - 13u48).

This is a temporary assignment during a busy and dynamic peak period. It's a great opportunity to gain experience in logistics. As Bleckmann operates multiple peak periods throughout the year (such as Black Friday in November), you will have the opportunity to return for future assignments.

Are you interested in this opportunity? Be sure to read this vacancy!

Tasks: 

• Preparing incoming orders

• You prepare the orders in order of arrival using a scanning system

• You prepare the correct documents when packing orders

We organize bus transport from Ghent to ensure easy access to Bleckmann:  

• Back and forth ride from the station of Gent-Sint-Pieters

• Departure at 5u10

 

• Positive attitude

• Good numerical skills

• Flexibility

• Punctuality

• Fluent in either Dutch, English or French

Satellit is seeking an experienced .NET developer with Java know-how to join a multi-disciplinary team delivering digital identity and authentication capabilities for a major energy-sector engagement. The role involves building, validating and documenting reusable authentication/authorization components, contributing to deployment automation, collaborating with IT stakeholders, and participating in agile squad activities. This position follows a hybrid work model with an expectation of being on-site about two days per week and is planned to start in the mid-October to mid-November timeframe. Full-time commitment is required.
Who are you?

What will you do?

• Design, implement, unit-test and document libraries, services or components that handle user authentication and authorization.

• Create example applications and code samples to illustrate how to integrate identity and access services into new or existing systems, and communicate these to engineering teams.

• Customize and extend commercial or open-source products (for example access managers, authorization engines, API gateways, reverse proxies and directory services) and produce supporting documentation for those extensions.

• Improve and automate continuous integration and continuous delivery workflows, including configuration and release automation.

• Work closely with IT and application teams to identify integration points, diagnose issues, and resolve problems when connecting to identity fabric services.

• Install and configure third-party and open-source components by following technical guides and producing any required deployment notes.

• Take part in squad sprint activities, including planning, execution and retrospective work.

• Own assigned backlog items, drive tasks to completion and report progress to the squad.

• Prepare for and actively participate in meetings and workshops, tracking actions and follow-ups.

• Propose technical solutions that align with requirements and constraints, present them to stakeholders and refine based on feedback.

• Continuously acquire new technical knowledge, standards and tooling needed to fulfill assigned work.

Technologies (mandatory)

• Hash Function

• cookie

• SAML/OAuth

• Keystore

• Microservices Architecture

• Bash

• Typescript

• oauth 2

• Security

• Symmetric Encryption

• Proxy

• Collaboration

• .NET

• PowerShell

• Git

• agile

• MS Teams

• product backlog management

• SAP IDM

• Continuous Integration

• Kubernetes

• Google OIDC

• SQL Server

• React Native

• advanced rest

• HTTPS

• SQL

• DevOps

• JavaScript

• YAML

• Blazor

• PKI

• Autonomy

• Teamwork

• Presentation skills

• Communication

• Continuous learning

• Technical documentation

• Analytical problem solving

• Resilience

• Versatility and adaptability

• Continuous integration and deployment practices

• Agile methodologies and Scrum

Preferred Qualifications:

• Proven experience with C# and the .NET ecosystem in a production environment.

• Practical knowledge of Java and familiarity with interoperation between Java and .NET components.

• Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs and working with JSON and YAML configurations.

• Hands-on skills with front-end technologies such as JavaScript and frameworks like Vue.js or Blazor.

• Understanding of directory services and authentication protocols (LDAP, OAuth2, OpenID Connect).

• Solid grasp of web security fundamentals including HTTPS, cookies, CORS, single sign-on and multifactor concepts.

• Familiarity with cryptographic basics including symmetric and asymmetric key usage, hashing and keystore concepts.

• Experience deploying and operating containerized applications and orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes (experience with managed clusters a plus).

• Comfortable using Git and participating in DevOps practices for source control and delivery pipelines.

• Database experience, for instance with SQL Server or similar relational databases.

• Nice-to-have: TypeScript, PowerShell, Bash scripting, React, SAML2, PKI experience, and familiarity with identity provider solutions (for example Keycloak, Ping, Okta, ADFS, or cloud identity services).

• Experience designing or operating microservices-based systems is an advantage.

• Strong interpersonal and soft skills: pragmatic problem-solving, autonomy, adaptability, resilience, clear communication, analytical thinking, and the ability to document and present technical work.

• Language requirements: good command of Dutch and/or French, plus English for technical collaboration.

For a dynamic international company in Merchtem, we are looking for an Inside Sales Representative who combines customer service with commercial flair and a technical interest. You enjoy working in a role where you interact daily with customers, the sales team and internal departments, and where you can make a real impact on business growth and customer satisfaction.

In this role, you will be the main commercial and customer-oriented point of contact for your region. Working closely with the External Sales Representative, you will build strong customer relationships and help expand the customer portfolio. You will manage a combination of new and existing customers, ensuring that everything runs smoothly and professionally, from quotations to follow-up.

Your responsibilities

• Acquiring new customers and further developing existing customer relationships.
• Growing existing accounts through cross-selling and upselling.
• Preparing and following up on quotations and price calculations.
• Processing orders and encouraging customers to use the E-Shop.
• Maintaining daily customer contact by phone and email, with a focus on commercial growth.
• Keeping customer information up to date in ERP/CRM systems.
• Identifying customer needs and commercial opportunities.
• Acting as the first point of contact for customer questions and support.
• Working closely with the External Sales Representative on reporting and follow-up.

• You have a strong hunter mentality and a clear commercial drive to win new customers.
• You have a commercial and/or technical background.
• You have experience in B2B sales, preferably in a technical environment.
• You are fluent in both spoken and written French and English.
• Knowledge of Arabic is an advantage but not a requirement.
• You are comfortable working with Excel and general IT tools.
• You have strong communication skills and a commercial mindset.

We are looking for packing employees who can work in three shifts and would like to work in the food industry in Dendermonde.

You will work in the packing department of a company that specializes in packing frozen products. You will work in a refrigerated environment (around 10 degrees Celsius).

• Checking the quality of products

• Packing all kinds of products (e.g. fish, snacks, vegetables, ...) in boxes or bags

• Sticking labels

• Stacking boxes on pallets

• Close communication with the operator

• ...

• You have previous experience in a production environment and can work flexible in three shifts.

• You do not mind performing physical work at pace.

• You have a good knowledge of the Dutch or English language in case of safety instructions.

• As the company is located in an industrial zone, it is not accessible by public transport. You can travel each day independently to Dendermonde.

• You are looking for long-term employment and do not mind performing a 2h packing test after a positive job interview.

You will be a member of our SEM/TEM team. This team is responsible for in-line and out-of-line released electron microscopy inspection.  As a TEM technician you ensure the smooth processing of the various TEM inspections, focusing on the quality of the inspection. 

As SEM/TEM technician you will have the following key responsibilities: 

• You follow-up the inline TEM queue.
• You adjust released recipes for automated TEM inspections.
• You are responsible for (semi)-automated and guided TEM inspections.
• You contribute to achieving targets.
• You help with statistical process control (SPC) on TEM tools. 

• Preferable you have a bachelor’s degree or associate degree (2-year program) in science (chemistry, biology, physics) or equal to experience.
• It would be a great plus if you have hands-on experience with automated metrology or SEM/TEM inspections in the semi-conductor industry.  
• You are a strong planner and you would enjoy working in a fast-paced environment. You certainly know how to multi-task and prioritize assignments.  
• You are a communicative team player with a very good knowledge of both English and Dutch.
• You are prepared to work in a shift system (early/late/night and 1 weekend out of 4).

Are you ready for a challenging career in the FAB Engineering team? Would you like to work with the most high-tech devices? Then read on quickly!

As an Equipment Maintenance Engineer, you'll start your journey in the esteemed FAB Engineering team:

• You'll get hands-on experience with the high-tech process equipment in our cleanroom. No need to be an expert from day one – we'll give you the time to thoroughly understand these cutting-edge tools. The team takes pride in maintaining and fine-tuning some of the most advanced equipment globally. You'll even get a chance to work with first versions and prototypes, which is pretty exciting!
• You will work closely with equipment manufacturers and other process engineers, so you'll be collaborating with a diverse group of experts.
• You’ll be part of the FAB Engineering team that consists of over 100 talented individuals with whom you will form the beating heart of our research institute. Specializing in nano-electronics, your work will contribute to technological solutions in various fields like healthcare and energy.

• You hold a Master's degree in Industrial Science with a focus on Electromechanics or Mechanics, or you have acquired equivalent technical experience. If you're just starting out, that's perfectly fine! We welcome motivated beginners who are eager to launch their careers.
• You are genuinely passionate about technology and equipment, and you are not afraid to work hands-on. Your technical knowledge of pneumatics, pumps, motors, electronics, and (electro)mechanics is a valuable asset.
• We highly appreciate your collaborative spirit, while also trusting your ability to proactively plan and organize your work on your own.
• You have a very good knowledge of English.
You will work in a shift regime: early - late (6u-14u & 14u-22u) and 1 weekend every 3 weeks

For a family-run company in the tyre sector, we are looking for an experienced tyre fitter to join the branch in Destelbergen.

Our client works for cars, trucks, agriculture and industry, and runs several branches across Belgium.

Hoe ziet jouw takenpakket eruit?
 
• You fit, repair and balance tyres. Plenty of trucks and agricultural vehicles, so proper work with heavy equipment. 
• You work cleanly and safely. A wheel that is not perfectly secured is never an option. 
• You step in wherever you are needed. In a small team, everyone pitches in. 
• After six months to a year, once you know the job inside out, you also join roadside call-outs. The employer pays for the training and your category C licence.
 
• Experience as a tyre fitter. By far the most important point on this list. 
• A category B driving licence. 
• Dutch or English is enough. If French is your main language, we do need a basic level of English on top of it so you can work smoothly with the team. No need to be fluent. 
• Someone who is punctual, gets stuck in and takes safety seriously. 
• The ambition to build something long term with one employer.

Our client, a well-established company in the food production industry located in Zottegem, is looking for a motivated and experienced Technical Operator.

Hoe ziet jouw takenpakket eruit?
As a Technical Operator, you play a crucial role in the production process.

You ensure that the production lines run efficiently and intervene quickly whenever deviations occur. Thanks to your technical insight, accuracy, and problem-solving skills, production continues smoothly.

Your responsibilities:
 
• Setting up, operating, and monitoring production lines. 
• Performing quality checks and making adjustments where necessary. 
• Detecting technical malfunctions and independently resolving minor defects. 
• Carrying out machine changeovers, cleaning your equipment, and ensuring machines function correctly. 
• Recording production data and strictly following established procedures. 
• Assisting with preventive maintenance and actively contributing ideas for process improvements. 
• Maintaining a safe, clean, and organized work environment at all times.
Working hours are from Monday to Friday in a two-shift system:
 
• Morning shift: 6:00 AM – 2:00 PM 
• Afternoon shift: 2:00 PM – 10:00 PM
 
• You have previous experience as a Technical Operator. 
• You have a strong technical interest and are eager to learn. 
• You are willing to work in a two-shift system. 
• You have a good command of Dutch and/or English. 
• You work accurately, responsibly, and have a strong focus on quality. 
• You can independently analyze and solve technical issues. 
• You perform well in a team and communicate effectively with colleagues. 
• You are stress-resistant and thrive in a production environment where pace is important. 
• You have a hands-on mentality and enjoy taking initiative. 
• You have your own transportation or can easily commute to the workplace. 
• You live within a 20 km radius of Zottegem.

For a banking customer in Brussels, we are searching for a freelance SQL DBA for a senior mission.
Responsibilities

• Help define, implement and maintain highly available, performant & scalable database systems to effectively meet IT Business requirements

• Be involved in deployment and patching automation

• Maintain (backups, transaction log management, index optimisation etc) and upgrade the database systems etc

• Review database schema changes to ensure compliance with standards and ensure optimal choice of indexing, column definitions etc.

• Help with problem solving in case of performance problems or functional issues in applications

• Build a strong relationship both within the infrastructure team and with the development teams

• Promote best practices

• Maintain the deployment pipeline

Additional details

Seniority: Medior/Senior

Start Date: October/November

Duration: Long-term

Extension: Yes

Contract: Freelance

Location: Brussels

Onsite Policy: 50%

Hours Per Week: 40

Languages: Fluent English and French/Dutch

Interview Process: 1 stage

• Expert knowledge of SQL Server administration, performance tuning, high availability and disaster recovery

• Strong experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, Oracle and enterprise database operations

• Hands-on experience with AWS database services (Aurora, RDS for SQL Server, PostgreSQL and MySQL, DynamoDB)

• Experience with Azure database services (Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, CosmosDB)

• Strong troubleshooting skills across database, operating system and infrastructure layers

• Experience with PowerShell and infrastructure automation

• Good knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory and Red Hat Linux

 

Strongly preferred:

• Experience with TerraForm, Ansible or similar Infrastructure-as-Code tools

• Experience with monitoring and observability platforms such as Redgate , Dynatrace, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor or equivalent

• Experience modernising legacy database platforms

• Experience with GIT, Jira and CI/CD-driven deployment processes

• Experience with cloud security, encryption, backup and disaster recovery solutions

• Experience with performance monitoring and capacity management in cloud environments

• Knowledge of Power BI, SSAS or reporting platforms

 

Nice to have:

• VMware vSphere and ESXi administration knowledge

• CommVault or enterprise backup solutions

• Basic networking and load-balancing (F5) concepts

• Azure Entra ID and Azure platform services

• Basic knowledge of Go or Python programming language

Soft skills

• Good communication skills enabling you to explain complex technical issues is an easy-to-understand way

• Like to keep up to date with the latest technology trends
